api_key.description: API key for admin endpoints (e.g., /admin/config). Must be set for security.

bind_address.description: Network address the discovery server listens on (e.g., 0.0.0.0, 127.0.0.1, or specific IP).

port.description: TCP port for discovery service (UDP not supported in current version).

max_conn_per_ip.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed per IP address. Helps prevent abuse.

rate_limit.description: Average rate limit (requests per second) per client IP over time.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum burst size (concurrent requests) before rate limiting kicks in.

metrics_bind.description: Metrics endpoint bind address (ignored if metrics disabled).

enable_pprof.description: Enable /debug/pprof endpoints (for performance profiling). Enable only in development or trusted environments.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for the main discovery endpoint.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS enabled.

items.description: Additional URLs to listen on (e.g., unix:///var/run/syncthing-discosrv.sock). Must be valid syncthing-discosrv URL schemes.

listen_urls.description: List of additional network or Unix socket URLs to accept connections on.

log_to_stdout.description: Print logs to standard output (useful for containerized deployments).

log_file.description: Path to log file (ignored if log_to_stdout is true).

pid_file.description: Path to write PID file. Used by service managers for process control.
